styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small shelved rack holding loaves. Its 15 visible tones per tile sit between the hedge (9) and the stall (17) and well (20), so it is not shallow. Near-flat coverage is 0%, and the stall reference has 13%. It has about 4 steps per material, slightly fewer than the roughly 5-6 on the stall and well, and fewer total colours (18 vs 38-40). A careful artist would still accept it next to the stall without it looking flat or sticker-like.
